title: Reassign can move work outside the filter, and it then leaves the view
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in on the Work Orders build under test with Work Orders view permission and Work Orders create-and-edit; the Board View and Tech View display options are on.
  2. The current location has at least 3 lead technicians shown as groups/columns (a technician is eligible when they are Clockable, Active, and their role is not Office or Time Clock User).
  3. Via New Work Order, create several work orders and set a Lead Technician on each, spread across the technicians with some left Unassigned; then open the Work Orders page.
  4. A filter applied that excludes some technicians; a work order whose reassignment will make it no longer match.
custom_steps:
1. Open Reassign lead technician on a filtered view.
  2. Confirm you can pick a destination technician outside the current filter.
  3. Confirm the reassignment; if the work order no longer matches the filter, confirm it is removed from the results.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The Reassign dialog lets you pick destinations that are outside the current filter.
  • After reassignment, a work order that no longer matches the filter is removed from the results.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043 (Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options). Story reference: SV-10047 — Story 4 Reassign or unassign the lead technician. Spec: Confluence page 845185030 “Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options (Draft Spec)”, Draft v0.9, requirement(s) S4-E4, S4-E8 (read 23 Sep 2026). Review decisions/answers: Confluence page 853901313 where cited. Source-verified on 23 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S4-E4: “The Reassign dialog allows destinations outside the current filter.”
  • S4-E8: “After reassignment, remove the work order from results if it no longer matches the filter.”
